status: OFFLINE PASS; real-VM ownership and M02 validation BLOCKED by sandbox prerequisites (no /dev/kvm, no privilege, no multi-range uid_map). Re-check confirms the same block. B6 remains open.
authorization: Operator authorized one disposable Fedora 44 VM, dependency installation, and deletion of only that fixture. No production access, existing VM use, commit, push or PR change.

review_finding.claim: ssh-keygen runs as root, so the private key is root-owned; the pre-fix helper chowned only KEYDIR and key.pub to hermes and then ran rootless 'podman unshare chown 10000:10000 key', which cannot change a root-owned inode from inside hermes's user namespace.
review_finding.verdict: CONFIRMED as a fresh-install blocker. Consistent with the reference pattern: m02-deploy-and-validate.sh:115 transfers only known_hosts and worker_client_ed25519.pub, and the private key it mapped-chowns at :122 was already hermes-owned from an earlier stage.
review_finding.fix: provision-worker-client-key.sh:109 now chowns KEYDIR, key and key.pub to hermes:hermes before the mapped-UID chown at :110. The private key is re-established as hermes-owned on every rerun, which also makes the rerun path safe.
review_finding.safety: Strictly safe either way: if rootless Podman could chown a root-owned inode, the added transfer is harmless; it matches the only ownership state the validated M02 path ever started from.
